heroHeadline: Infantino Faces FIFA Member Revolt in Zurich Over Failed World Cup Stake Sale
heroSubtitle: FIFA president Gianni Infantino faces a revolt from member federations in Zurich after a failed attempt to sell a stake in the 2026 World Cup tournament, deepening governance tensions. The FIFA Council meets Oct 15 amid calls for a governance review ahead of the March 2027 presidential election in Morocco.
